title: 雨夜外卖
music: tense urban night drama underscore, low strings, sparse piano, pulsing low synth, rain mood, slow build, instrumental, no vocals
logline: A soaked delivery rider walks into his ex-girlfriend's engagement dinner, is humiliated and thrown into the rain, and then learns he is the sole heir of the Chen Group, which owns the restaurant.

clips.summary: At the engagement dinner in {loc}, {linwei} freezes as the door opens: the soaked delivery rider is {chenmo}. {zihang} complains the food is late.
clips.soundscape: Muffled heavy rain against the window, clink of glasses and murmured celebration from the table, the chandelier's faint hum.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwei} alone at the dinner table, a crystal wine glass of red wine raised near her chin, the chandelier glittering out of focus behind her; no one else in frame.
cuts.action: {linwei}'s smile has already frozen: she stares wide-eyed toward the door, lips parted in shock, and the red wine trembles in her glass.
cuts.camera: Fast push in on her stunned face.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: the round table with the engagement cake in the foreground, {zihang} and {linwei} seated side by side on the left among a few out-of-focus guests, and on the right the double door open with {chenmo} standing in it in his dripping blue raincoat, a white delivery bag in his hand.
cuts.action: {chenmo} steps in from the doorway; rainwater drips from his raincoat onto the red carpet.
cuts.camera: Slow dolly back across the table, revealing the room.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.line: 您好，您的外卖。
cuts.say: 您好，您的外卖。
cuts.act: 平静、礼貌，声音低，带着雨里跑来的一点喘
cuts.delivery: polite and even, slightly out of breath, water dripping from his hair
cuts.composition: Held chest-up medium close-up of {chenmo} composed off-centre to the right, wet hair, raindrops on his face, the door frame dark behind him.
cuts.action: {chenmo} holds up the delivery bag a little.

cuts.speaker: zihang
cuts.line: 迟到了十二分钟。
cuts.say: 迟到了……十二分钟。
cuts.act: 懒洋洋地瞥一眼手表，拖着腔调，不屑
cuts.delivery: bored and contemptuous, glancing at his gold watch
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zihang} at the table, the chandelier soft behind him.
cuts.action: {zihang} lifts his wrist and glances at his gold watch without looking up at the rider.
cuts.camera: Slight tilt up from the watch to his face.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.line: 雨太大，路上封了一段。
cuts.say: 雨太大，路上……封了一段。
cuts.act: 平稳地解释，不卑不亢
cuts.delivery: steady, matter-of-fact
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {zihang}'s blurred slicked-back head onto {chenmo} standing by the door.
cuts.action: {chenmo} answers evenly, rain still dripping off his sleeve.

clips.summary: {linwei} whispers his name; {zihang} realises who he is, sneers, and dumps the food on the carpet.
clips.soundscape: Rain against the window, the guests fall quiet, a chair creaks.

cuts.speaker: linwei
cuts.line: 陈默？
cuts.say: 陈……陈默？
cuts.act: 极低声，不敢相信，声音发虚
cuts.delivery: barely audible, stunned, lips parting
cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwei}, the wine glass still in her hand, the chandelier blurred behind.
cuts.action: {linwei} lowers the glass slowly, staring.

cuts.speaker: zihang
cuts.line: 哦——原来是你那个送外卖的前男友啊。
cuts.say: 哦——原来是你那个……送外卖的前男友啊。
cuts.act: 先愣一下，然后拉长音笑出来，轻蔑地拖腔
cuts.delivery: a slow amused smirk spreading, mocking
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zihang}, leaning back in his chair.
cuts.action: {zihang} looks at {linwei}, then back at {chenmo}, and a smirk spreads across his face.
cuts.camera: Slow push in as the smirk grows.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo} by the door, wet hair, the room soft behind him.
cuts.action: {chenmo}'s jaw tightens; he says nothing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot beside the table: {zihang} standing up and taking the white delivery bag from {chenmo}'s hand.
cuts.action: {zihang} takes the bag, holds it out at arm's length and turns it upside down; the containers fall.
cuts.camera: Handheld, tilting down with the falling food.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of the deep-red carpet as the takeaway containers burst open, rice and broth splattering across it.
cuts.action: The food splashes onto the carpet.

clips.summary: {zihang} refuses the late food and demands that {chenmo} kneel and apologise; {linwei} looks away.
clips.soundscape: Rain against the window, an uneasy silence at the table.

cuts.speaker: zihang
cuts.line: 迟到的东西，我不要。差评，退款。
cuts.say: 迟到的东西，我不要。差评……退款。
cuts.act: 居高临下，慢条斯理，最后两个词一字一顿
cuts.delivery: looking down his nose, savouring each word
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {zihang} standing over the spilled food, slightly low angle.
cuts.action: {zihang} dusts off his hands.
cuts.camera: Slight low angle, static then a slow push in.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo}, looking down.
cuts.action: {chenmo}'s eyes drop to the food on the floor; he does not move.
cuts.camera: Slow tilt down following his eyes.

cuts.speaker: zihang
cuts.line: 怎么，不服气？跪下道歉，我就不投诉你。
cuts.say: 怎么，不服气？跪下……道歉，我就不投诉你。
cuts.act: 挑衅地笑，凑近，压低声音像在施舍
cuts.delivery: leaning in with a taunting smile
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {chenmo}'s wet blue raincoat shoulder onto {zihang}, who leans in close.
cuts.action: {zihang} leans in, smiling, and points at the floor.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwei} at the table, the chandelier soft behind.
cuts.action: {linwei}'s fingers tighten on the stem of her glass; she cannot look up.

clips.summary: {wangjl} hurries in; {zihang} complains; {wangjl} shoves {chenmo} and orders him to apologise.
clips.soundscape: The door bangs open, rain louder for a moment from the corridor, then the room's tense quiet.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the double door as {wangjl} pushes it open and hurries in.
cuts.action: {wangjl} bustles in, buttoning his waistcoat, eyes darting across the room.

cuts.speaker: wangjl
cuts.line: 赵少，怎么了？
cuts.say: 赵少，怎么了？
cuts.act: 点头哈腰，讨好，语气急
cuts.delivery: fawning, bowing slightly
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {wangjl}, the chandelier light on his shiny forehead.
cuts.action: {wangjl} bows his head toward {zihang}, wringing his hands.

cuts.speaker: zihang
cuts.line: 你们这儿什么人都放进来？
cuts.say: 你们这儿……什么人都放进来？
cuts.act: 不耐烦，嫌弃地质问
cuts.delivery: irritated, disgusted
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {wangjl}'s round shoulder onto {zihang}.
cuts.action: {zihang} jerks his chin toward the rider.

cuts.speaker: wangjl
cuts.line: 还不快给赵少道歉！
cuts.say: 还不快——给赵少道歉！
cuts.act: 翻脸，声音一下拔高，凶
cuts.delivery: face turning hard, barking
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {wangjl} turning sharply.
cuts.action: {wangjl} wheels on {chenmo}, his face hardening.
cuts.camera: Quick whip pan with his turn.

cuts.composition: Medium shot near the door: {wangjl} facing {chenmo}.
cuts.action: {wangjl} shoves {chenmo} hard in the chest; {chenmo} staggers back a step.

cuts.speaker: wangjl
cuts.line: 弄脏了地毯你赔得起吗？
cuts.say: 弄脏了地毯——你赔得起吗？
cuts.act: 指着鼻子骂，又凶又势利
cuts.delivery: jabbing a finger, snarling
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {wangjl}, finger pointing.
cuts.action: {wangjl} jabs his finger at the stained carpet and then at {chenmo}.

clips.summary: {chenmo} apologises for being late but refuses to kneel; {linwei} begs him to give in.
clips.soundscape: Rain on the window, a guest's chair scrapes, otherwise silence.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.line: 饭是我送迟了，我道歉。
cuts.say: 饭是我送迟了，我道歉。
cuts.act: 站稳，语气平静，不急不缓
cuts.delivery: steadying himself, calm, meeting his eyes
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {chenmo}, rain still on his face.
cuts.action: {chenmo} straightens up and looks {zihang} in the eye.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {zihang}.
cuts.action: {zihang}'s smirk widens, expecting him to kneel.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.line: 但跪，不可能。
cuts.say: 但跪……不可能。
cuts.act: 压低声音，一字一顿，很稳，没有怒气
cuts.delivery: quiet and immovable
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {zihang}'s blurred shoulder onto {chenmo}.
cuts.action: {chenmo} holds his gaze without blinking.

cuts.speaker: linwei
cuts.line: 陈默，你就服个软吧……你斗不过他的。
cuts.say: 陈默，你就服个软吧……你斗不过他的。
cuts.act: 别过脸去，声音发紧，又劝又躲，不敢看他
cuts.delivery: turning her face away, voice tight
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {linwei}, face half turned away from him.
cuts.action: {linwei} turns her face away as she speaks.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo}.
cuts.action: {chenmo} looks at her; something in his eyes goes dark.

clips.summary: {chenmo} reminds {linwei} she said the same three years ago; {wangjl} drags him out.
clips.soundscape: Rain on the window, silence at the table.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.line: 三年前你走的时候，也是这么说的。
cuts.say: 三年前你走的时候……也是这么说的。
cuts.act: 很轻，很平，像在说别人的事，尾音一沉
cuts.delivery: quiet, flat, the hurt held back
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {linwei}'s long black hair onto {chenmo}.
cuts.action: {chenmo} looks down at her, unmoving.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwei}.
cuts.action: {linwei} flinches; her eyes glisten and she stares at the tablecloth.

cuts.composition: Medium shot by the double door.
cuts.action: {wangjl} grabs {chenmo} by the arm and hauls him out through the door.

clips.summary: In the pouring rain {wangjl} throws {chenmo} down the steps into a puddle; his phone rings.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain hammering on the canopy and the street, water splashing, distant traffic.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc} in the downpour: {wangjl} at the top of the steps in the lit doorway, {chenmo} pitching forward down the steps.
cuts.action: {wangjl} shoves {chenmo} out; {chenmo} stumbles down the steps and falls into the puddle at the bottom.
cuts.camera: Static wide, rain streaking through the light.

cuts.speaker: wangjl
cuts.line: 以后别让我在云顶看见你！
cuts.say: 以后——别让我在云顶看见你！
cuts.act: 站在台阶上居高临下地吼，盖过雨声
cuts.delivery: shouting down over the rain
cuts.composition: Close-up of {wangjl} under the canopy, slightly low angle, warm light behind him.
cuts.action: {wangjl} points down at him and spits the words.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo} on his hands and knees in the puddle, rain pouring over his face.
cuts.action: {chenmo} looks up at the door, rain running down his face.
cuts.camera: Low, static, rain falling through frame.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {chenmo} alone at the foot of the steps in the rain.
cuts.action: {chenmo} slowly gets to his feet, water streaming from his raincoat; a phone buzzes in his pocket.
cuts.camera: Slow crane up as he rises.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of the wet black phone in {chenmo}'s hand, the screen glowing with an incoming call, rain beading on the glass.
cuts.action: The phone vibrates in his hand.

clips.summary: On the phone, {suqing} introduces herself and tells {chenmo} the old chairman died last night.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain on the street; inside the car the rain is a muffled drumming on the roof.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 陈默先生吗？我是陈氏集团董事长秘书苏晴。
cuts.say: 陈默先生吗？我是陈氏集团董事长秘书，苏晴。
cuts.act: 冷静、职业化，吐字清楚，不带情绪
cuts.delivery: composed and businesslike, phone at her ear
cuts.composition: Held chest-up medium close-up of {suqing} composed off-centre in the back seat of a dark car parked in the rain, a phone at her ear, rain streaming down the window beside her, the warm restaurant lights blurred beyond.
cuts.action: {suqing} speaks into the phone, looking out through the rain-streaked window.
cuts.camera: Static, rain shadows moving across her face.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo} in the rain with the phone at his ear.
cuts.action: {chenmo} frowns, listening.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 老董事长昨晚去世了。
cuts.say: 老董事长……昨晚去世了。
cuts.act: 放低一点声音，克制地通知
cuts.delivery: quiet and restrained
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {suqing} in the back seat of the dark car, rain on the window beside her.
cuts.action: {suqing} lowers her eyes for a moment.

clips.summary: {suqing} tells {chenmo} he is the sole heir of the Chen Group, that the restaurant belongs to it, and that the car is already here.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain, a car engine idling somewhere close.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 按照遗嘱，您是陈氏集团唯一的继承人。
cuts.say: 按照遗嘱，您是陈氏集团……唯一的继承人。
cuts.act: 电话里的声音，平稳清晰，每个字都很确定
cuts.delivery: heard over the phone, composed and certain
cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo} with the phone at his ear, rain running down his face, the lit glass door blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {chenmo} stands completely still; rain runs down his face.
cuts.camera: Slow push in on his eyes.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 另外，云顶餐厅也是集团的产业。
cuts.say: 另外……云顶餐厅，也是集团的产业。
cuts.act: 公事公办，语气不变
cuts.delivery: even, precise
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {suqing} in the back seat of the dark car, looking out at the restaurant through the rainy window.
cuts.action: {suqing} glances out of the window at the restaurant door.
cuts.camera: Rack focus from the rain on the window to her face.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo}, the phone at his ear.
cuts.action: {chenmo} slowly turns his head toward the glowing restaurant door.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 车已经在门口了。
cuts.say: 车，已经在门口了。
cuts.act: 干脆利落
cuts.delivery: brisk, reaching for the door handle
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {suqing} in the back seat of the dark car.
cuts.action: {suqing} lowers the phone and reaches for the door handle.

clips.summary: A black sedan pulls up; {suqing} steps out with an umbrella, bows to {chenmo} and calls him Chairman Chen. At the door, {wangjl} goes white.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain, tyres hissing on the wet street, a car door opening, an umbrella snapping open.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: {chenmo} alone in the rain at the foot of the steps as a long black sedan glides up to the kerb beside him.
cuts.action: The sedan's headlights cut through the curtain of rain and it stops beside him.
cuts.camera: Static wide, headlight beams sweeping across the rain.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the sedan's rear door.
cuts.action: {suqing} steps out of the sedan and opens a large black umbrella.
cuts.camera: Low angle, slow tilt up as she rises.

cuts.composition: Medium two-shot in the rain: {suqing} facing {chenmo} at the foot of the steps.
cuts.action: {suqing} holds the umbrella over {chenmo} and bows slightly.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 陈董，请上车。
cuts.say: 陈董，请上车。
cuts.act: 恭敬但不卑，声音清楚有力
cuts.delivery: respectful, composed, holding the umbrella over him
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {chenmo}'s wet blue raincoat shoulder onto {suqing} under the black umbrella.
cuts.action: {suqing} gestures toward the open car door.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {wangjl} in the lit glass doorway at the top of the steps, rain falling between him and the street.
cuts.action: {wangjl}'s face drains white and his mouth falls open.
cuts.camera: Slow push in on his face.
